RENDER_TIMEOUT.meaning: Raised when a worker exceeds the render time budget for the job's class without completing. The watchdog reaps the job and releases the worker slot.
RENDER_TIMEOUT.remediation: Check whether other jobs on the same worker also timed out in the same window. If they did, drain the worker rather than retrying individually. If the failure is isolated, a single retry is safe.

RENDER_STALLED.meaning: Raised when a worker stops emitting progress heartbeats for three consecutive intervals while still holding an active render lease. The job made partial progress and then went silent.
RENDER_STALLED.remediation: Confirm the worker process is alive. A stalled render with a live worker indicates a hung decoder; restart the worker agent. A stalled render with a dead worker is safe to requeue immediately.

UPLOAD_TIMEOUT.meaning: Raised when the upload stage cannot flush finished frames to object storage inside the delivery window. Render compute completed successfully; only delivery failed.
UPLOAD_TIMEOUT.remediation: Check storage egress throttling before retrying. Retrying during an active throttle window will fail identically. The rendered frames remain in the scratch prefix for 24 hours.

ASSET_UNSUPPORTED_CODEC.meaning: The submitted source asset uses a codec the render pipeline cannot decode. This is a deterministic input error, not an infrastructure fault.
ASSET_UNSUPPORTED_CODEC.remediation: Do not retry. Ask the submitter to re-encode the source to a supported codec. Retrying will fail identically and consumes queue capacity.

WORKER_EVICTED.meaning: The worker host was reclaimed by the infrastructure layer mid-render, typically a spot-capacity reclamation. The job was lost through no fault of its own.
WORKER_EVICTED.remediation: Safe to retry immediately. This is the canonical transient failure and is exempt from the retry backoff cap.

QUEUE_SHED_DEFERRED.meaning: The scheduler shed this batch-priority job because queue depth crossed the shedding threshold. The job was deferred, not failed.
QUEUE_SHED_DEFERRED.remediation: No action required; the job re-enters admission automatically when depth falls. Promote to standard priority only if the deadline genuinely requires it.

STORAGE_BACKPRESSURE.meaning: Object storage signalled sustained backpressure and the pipeline throttled the upload stage fleet-wide to avoid amplifying the incident.
STORAGE_BACKPRESSURE.remediation: Fleet-wide condition; individual retries will not help. Check for a concurrent batch export window and wait for the throttle to clear.

FONT_MISSING.meaning: A text overlay referenced a font that is not present in the render image's font set. Deterministic input error.
FONT_MISSING.remediation: Do not retry. Either embed the font in the submission or ask for a substitution from the supported set.
